import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

The TUI is slow because the Agents inbox heap grew to archive scale, then CPython stop-the-world GC hitching on the UI thread. Extra TUI machinery will not fix that.

**Recommended solution:** one TUI-plus-core epic that shrinks what Python holds, then measure with the loggers you already have.

1. Treat a live inbox row as marker-true. Repair the 17,604 `status=running` rows with `has_running_marker=0` in Rust, off the TUI.
2. Stop holding the list as fat `AgentArtifactRecordWire`. Use a slim list DTO, hydrate the selected row only, drop wires after `Agent` is built, and keep one snapshot generation (today the cache is 8).
3. Leave GC policy and j/k as follow-ups until that heap is bounded.

**Do not** rewrite Textual, add workers/procs, disable GC, or add production loggers. Unset `SASE_TUI_GC_CENSUS` (the 8.1M-object walk cost 11.5s on MainThread). Rotate the stale 585MB `tui_trace.jsonl`. One short TRACE after the heap epic is enough.

Live evidence on 2026-11-16 (PID 2180945, 0.19.0, lock-busy and tick-trim already in):

- Mount 6.25s (construct 5.22s + import 1.68s); `agents_ready` 11.6s; last-7d p95 `agents_ready` 41s.
- RSS 5.2GB at 16s, 35GB at 5.4min, then swap. Census: 208k wires vs 131 visible Agents. Gen2 GC 50.6s; stall 51.5s; ~70 hitch/h, 100% on the Agents tab.
- Index query 0.24–0.70s; decode of the same 131-row inbox grew 2.1s → 22.3s as the heap grew. Monitor reconcile 11.7s at startup (GIL via `asyncio.to_thread`).

P0 acceptance: idle RSS <1.5GB; wire survivors O(visible rows); 131-row decode p95 <200ms; idle gen2 p95 ≤0.5s; hitch share <0.5%; ~0 hitch/30min idle; 0 source scans on ordinary refresh.
